👨‍💻 Sabiway API Documentation - Profiles (Admin Endpoints)

Admin-only endpoints for managing user profiles.

Retrieve all user profiles (admin only, with full details).

Response:
[
  {
    "user_id": 1,
    "username": "@johndoe",
    "full_name": "John Doe",
    "email": "john@example.com",
    "followers_count": 10,
    "following_count": 5,
    "posts_count": 3,
    "is_active": true
  },
  {
    "user_id": 2,
    "username": "@janedoe",
    "full_name": "Jane Doe",
    "email": "jane@example.com",
    "followers_count": 15,
    "following_count": 7,
    "posts_count": 6,
    "is_active": true
  }
]

Retrieve detailed information of a single user profile (admin only).

Response:
{
  "user_id": 2,
  "username": "@janedoe",
  "full_name": "Jane Doe",
  "email": "jane@example.com",
  "followers_count": 15,
  "following_count": 7,
  "posts_count": 6,
  "is_active": true
}

Update a user’s profile details (admin only).

Request Body:
{
  "full_name": "Jane Smith",
  "is_active": false
}

Response:
{
  "user_id": 2,
  "username": "@janedoe",
  "full_name": "Jane Smith",
  "email": "jane@example.com",
  "followers_count": 15,
  "following_count": 7,
  "posts_count": 6,
  "is_active": false
}

Partially update your own profile. Only send the fields you want to change. 

Request Body:
{
  "phone_number": "+2348012345678"
}

Response:
{
  "user_id": 1,
  "username": "johndoe",
  "full_name": "Johnny Doe",
  "email": "john@example.com",
  "phone_number": "+2348012345678",
  "followers_count": 10,
  "following_count": 5,
  "posts_count": 3
}

Delete a user’s profile (admin only, irreversible).

Response:
{
  "message": "Profile deleted successfully by admin"
}
